content.text: Everyone, take a look. I have all the documents here. Could you please verify them?
@Old Zhang I've seen the documents, everything's fine.
@Old Zhang Okay, everyone, please double-check that all your documents are in order.
My suitcase is a bit messy; how can I fit everything in?
@小白, your clothes are spread out like you're about to move. Maybe take a look at Vicky's organizing method for reference.
@小白 The storage bag is indeed a good solution, as it can save a lot of space.
Look at my suitcase; using packing cubes makes it much neater.
@Vicky It's as neat as a supermarket shelf, truly well-organized.
@Vicky I need to learn your way of organizing things; it's so useful.
My camera bag is so heavy. @大伟, do you think the flight will be delayed?
Blizzard warning, temperature -31 degrees, flights may indeed be delayed.
@David, that doesn't sound good. We need to prepare in advance.
@David, then let's head to the airport early just in case.
Even a blizzard can't stop me from bringing my snacks, haha.
@Fat Tiger, your snacks bring warmth.
Everyone, take a look at my camera bag. It's so heavy; I really don't know what to do with it.
@Mia, your photography gear is indeed impressive, but do you really use all those lenses?
@Mia, maybe consider bringing only two lenses? That way, you can at least lighten the load a bit.
Look at this weather forecast, there's a blizzard warning, flights might be delayed.
@David No way, if I had known earlier, I would have brought more dry provisions.
Hope the delay won't be too long. @David, do you think there's a possibility the flight might be canceled?
@Old Zhang, the snow is so heavy that it's uncertain whether the plane can take off. Delays are probably unavoidable.

In this kind of blizzard weather, planes have to be de-iced before takeoff. If the runway is icy, planes can't brake properly, and if the wings are icy, it affects lift. It takes 20 to 30 minutes to de-ice just one plane, and with so many planes in line, it's definitely going to be a long wait.
But I brought plenty of snacks, so we can all share.
@Fat Tiger, you're so thoughtful. Snacks are a must for traveling.
Haha, @Fat Tiger, your snack box is really a must-have for traveling.
Now I'm starting to worry about my luggage. How can I fit everything in?
@小白, you can refer to @Vicky's organization method, it should be helpful.
@小白 I can help you organize together; categorization is very important.
I hope we can set off smoothly; I've been looking forward to this trip for a long time.
Yeah, I hope everything goes smoothly. Is everyone ready?
Everyone, help me find the other one of this glove!
@小白, try flipping over the bottom of the box; it might be hidden under the clothes.
@小白, could the gloves have been left in the car? Do you want to retrace your steps?
The snow is so heavy that it's uncertain whether the plane can take off. Everyone should be prepared to wait.
First, confirm everyone's electronic boarding passes and pay attention to the flight information.
@Old Zhang I've already checked my boarding pass to make sure everything is fine.
@Old Zhang It seems everyone's documents are in order, just waiting for the snow to stop.
Everyone, look at the big screen—the flight delay notice has turned red.
@Mia Looks like we'll be staying at the airport a bit longer. Let's find a place to sit down.
I'll go check if there are any available seats in the VIP lounge. Everyone can head over there first.
Then I'll go get some hot drinks. What does everyone want?
@Fat Tiger, I'll just have a cup of coffee, so waiting won't be tiring.
I want a hot chocolate to warm up.
I would like a cup of green tea, thank you, Fat Tiger.
Then let's wait for news in the lounge, hoping the weather improves soon.
Everyone, take a look at the buffet in the VIP lounge—it's really great!
@Vicky Wow, that makes me hungry just looking at it. I'll definitely go try it later.
@Vicky I happen to be hungry too, let's go sit there first.
This is my current state, sitting on a suitcase, lost in thought.
@Xiao Bai Don't worry, the gloves will definitely be found.
@小白 Your selfie reminds me of the long wait; I hope we can board the plane soon.
Everyone, look at the blizzard outside the window. The snow is so heavy that it's uncertain whether the plane can take off.
@David The weather is really getting worse and worse. I hope the flight won't be canceled.
@David, the snow is really heavy. It looks like we'll have to prepare for a long wait.
I hope the VIP lounge can provide some entertainment facilities so that waiting won't be so boring.
We can find something to do, or play a little game together?
Good idea, but right now I just want to find my gloves...
@Xiao Bai, let's check the lounge later; it might have fallen there.
It looks like we'll have to wait until the blizzard subsides a bit before we can take off.
Then let's go to the lounge for some food while we wait for the news.
Finally boarded. Looking at the view from the wing, visibility still isn't great.
@David, Yeah, the snow is really heavy, no wonder the flight has been delayed for so long.
@David, I hope there won't be any more delays from now on, otherwise I can hardly contain my excitement for this camera.
Everyone has worked hard. I'll treat you all to a hot drink after we get off the plane.
@Fat Tiger Okay, I hope this journey can end smoothly.
Look at the thick snow on the ground; it's quite a challenge.
@Old Zhang, it seems our itinerary will have some inconveniences, but it also offers us a different experience.
I hope I can find my gloves, otherwise I'll freeze in this snow.
@小白 I'll help you look for it again, don't worry. Just keep your hands in your pockets for now.
Everyone, be careful. Xiao Bai's gloves will definitely be found.
@小白 Maybe it's in your backpack. I remember you put something in there before we set off.
If you really can't find it, just buy a new pair. Safety comes first.
Finally landed, let's take a group photo to remember this moment!
@David This group photo looks great. Despite the twists and turns of the journey, everyone had a wonderful time together.
Yes, we've been through a lot together, and I look forward to the journey ahead.

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 大家确认了证件无误，小白的行李比较凌乱，Vicky展示了收纳技巧。大伟提醒暴雪可能导致航班延误。
(第2段摘要): 米娅展示了她的相机包，担心重量问题。大伟展示了暴雪天气预报，提到航班可能延误。胖虎展示了他的零食箱，大家讨论行李和收纳问题。
(第3段摘要): 小白在寻找丢失的手套，大家确认电子登机牌并注意到航班延误信息。部分人计划到VIP休息室等待，胖虎负责去买热饮。
(第4段摘要): 大家在机场等待时，Vicky展示了VIP休息室的自助餐以舒缓气氛。小白因找不到手套而发呆。大伟展示窗外的暴雪提醒航班可能延误，大家讨论如何打发时间。
(第5段摘要): 经过延误后，大家终于登机并顺利抵达目的地。在厚厚的积雪中，他们拍摄了一张合影，记录下这次特别的旅程。小白的手套问题仍未解决，但大家保持乐观，计划继续寻找。
